verdict.rationale: Vestd documents fixed, built-in automations, such as Companies House being updated automatically after shares are distributed, and an HRIS data sync. Nothing in the pack shows users can define their own event-triggered rules or actions, so these are adjacent features, not the story's capability. The axis applies to an equity-management SaaS, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
